text: New: an interactive unit circle. Drag the point or tap any angle to see sin, cos and tan with exact values, watch the sine and cosine waves move with it, and drill the 16 special angles until you know them by sight.
New: Quiz 5 cheat sheet: shape from f′ and f″, l'Hospital and the other indeterminate forms, curve sketching, optimization, Newton's method and antiderivatives. Tap a card for the full explanation.

New: Quiz 5 tab with §4.2–4.9 (shape of a graph, l'Hospital's Rule, curve sketching, optimization, Newton's method, antiderivatives). 53 practice problems you can step through line by line, a Quiz 5 study plan, quick-quiz questions and flashcards.

New: Quiz 3 & 4 review with every problem solved line by line, and a Midterm 2 practice exam shaped like the real one (Quiz 1–2 problems plus harder Quiz 3 & 4 twins, 52 points) with a live score bar. Plus new animations across the site.
New: Midterm 2 crash course. Every section from §2.8 to §4.1 in 10 short lessons, with 19 examples you step through one line at a time.
Midterm 2 moved to Thu, Nov 5. New: a plan for tonight, a checklist for every section, and Midterm 2 (everything) modes in the quick quiz and problem generator.
Quick quiz now has 18 Quiz 4 questions, and Memorize has a full Quiz 4 section with 45 flashcards. Both follow the Quiz 4 / Quiz 3 switch in the top bar.
New for Quiz 4: every problem in 3.6, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 and 4.1 has a “Step through it like a debugger” button. It walks the solution one line at a time, with a Why box and a Watch panel.
New: inverse trig step-by-step (like tan⁻¹(eˣ)) with 20 solved problems on 3.6, and trig derivative proofs (like cot x → −csc²x) on 3.3.
New: a Midterm 2 plan with a timed mock midterm, and a grade calculator showing what you need for an A or B.
Quiz 4 is here: lessons, labs and 79 solved problems for 3.6, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 and 4.1, plus a study plan and countdown.
Cleaner top bar: Quick quiz, Generate, Memorize and Cheat sheet are now in one Study tools menu.
New: sign in with email or Google to save your progress and sync it across all your devices.
New Generate page: unlimited practice problems with solutions, and a checker for any derivative you make up.
Cheat sheet cards now open a pop-up with the full explanation and examples. Also fixed the flashcard flip in Safari.
New math cursors (∫, Σ, ∂, Δ) and a site logo for your browser tab, home screen and shared links.
Q16, Q17 and Q18 now have full step-by-step implicit differentiation explanations, plus hints.
Q15 now has a full step-by-step explanation of the chain rule with eˣ, plus a hint.
Q14 now has a full step-by-step chain rule explanation, plus a hint.
New Memory tricks page with a flashcard drill for every derivative and rule.
Q8 now has a full step-by-step quotient rule explanation, plus a hint.
New lesson on 3.1: slope of the tangent vs. the tangent line.
Q3 now explains in depth why |x − 2| is not differentiable at 2.
